pkgmetadata.longdescription: libdatachannel is a standalone C/C++ implementation of WebRTC Data Channels, WebRTC Media Transport and WebSockets. It uses net-libs/libjuice for ICE and net-libs/usrsctp for SCTP. media-gfx/orcaslicer uses it for printer camera streams.

use.flag: Enable WebRTC media transport (SRTP) via net-libs/libsrtp
Enable WebSocket client and server support
